title: Add exact dirty-input coefficient audit for P112 tetrad block
body:
## Summary

Add a scoped exact audit of one P112 tetrad block in PR #3566. The checker reconstructs the first mapped block from the pinned predecessor geometry, extracts all 12,544 coefficients of its 112-port contribution, and confirms the four signed-coordinate terms reproduce the full within-block Gram matrix while vanishing on all other port coordinates.

A corruption control appends one formal helper variable to one term. The complete selected-port projection remains unchanged, but the helper coefficient column is nonzero in eight outputs. This demonstrates that the port identity alone cannot establish independence from the provider's 480 separate dirty helpers.

## Scope

This confirms the coefficient-only identity in PR #3566 and identifies its physical dirty-input contract as a separate obligation. It does not allege a defect in #3566, whose description already says no source-bound dirty-input implementation is included. The result adds no physical supplier, cost improvement, κ change, or selected-frontier update.

Live overlap also includes PR #3604's arbitrary-dirty-baseline co-delivery identity and PR #3632's corrected selected scatter replay with dirty-input controls. This package audits one port block and the inference boundary; it does not duplicate those full-word results or claim a native schedule for the 56 tetrad terms.

## Verification

- python3 -B research/p112-tetrad-dirty-coefficient-audit-laptop04/verify.py → PASS_P112_TETRAD_DIRTY_COEFFICIENT_AUDIT coefficients=12544 helper_corruption_detected=true no_new_kappa on Python 3.14.8.
- python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-dirty-coefficient-audit-laptop04 --check-only → PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS.
- The registered Python 3.12 replay was not run because Python 3.12 is unavailable in this environment.

## Credit

Retains attribution to the P112 tetrad identity's predecessor package, Gonzalo Mier's selected-port binding in PR #3566, and jwr's fixed-alphabet rank screen in PR #3567. Apache-2.0; prepared with substantial GPT-6 Luna xhigh assistance.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-dirty-coefficient-audit-laptop04` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-tetrad-dirty-coefficient-audit-laptop04 --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
